policy.render_mode: contain; no recolor, filter, gradient mask, shadow, or dark field

assets.specific_physical_scene: A row of four increasingly specialized test bays: bulk compression, defect scanning, reaction vessel, and interface microscopy, receding across a bare laboratory floor.
assets.single_mechanism: each material environment is routed to the level of test equipment its complexity requires

assets.specific_physical_scene: A long laboratory bench with many empty ceramic sample boats entering a small tube furnace and only one finished electrolyte pellet resting in a coin-cell test clamp.
assets.single_mechanism: the narrow furnace-to-test route makes the physical synthesis bottleneck visible

assets.specific_physical_scene: Two parallel rows of four unmarked engineering coupons on stepped mechanical pedestals; both rows preserve the same order while the pedestal heights differ.
assets.single_mechanism: the pedestal ordering shows rank agreement despite mismatched measured magnitude

assets.specific_physical_scene: A dense row of identical displacement probes scanning across one ceramic-to-metal interface in a practical cell cross-section.
assets.single_mechanism: the local probe readings join into one smooth indigo correction band along the interface

assets.specific_physical_scene: A risk-routing bench where candidate trays approach one mechanical evidence gate; several stop in side bays and one continues toward a small pilot reactor.
assets.single_mechanism: the evidence gate routes insufficient candidates aside before pilot equipment

assets.specific_physical_scene: A row of solid-electrolyte coupons mounted in identical diffusion rigs, with a sparse set of shared reference pins aligned across all rigs.
assets.single_mechanism: the shared reference pins anchor comparison of migration barriers across the coupon panel

assets.specific_physical_scene: A broad array of untouched electrolyte coupons surrounding a compact central route through three shared physical diffusion-test stations.
assets.single_mechanism: the union route reuses shared stations instead of repeating every possible barrier test

assets.specific_physical_scene: A calibration artifact in a sealed cradle connected by an unbroken physical chain of couplers to a specimen archive and a test instrument.
assets.single_mechanism: the coupler chain makes every instrument result traceable to the calibration artifact

assets.specific_physical_scene: A central instrument bench with one calibrated sample holder connected by a restrained indigo line to a compact water-filtration pilot skid across the room.
assets.single_mechanism: the calibrated holder transfers a measured material result into one filtration pilot decision

assets.specific_physical_scene: A low evidence table holding three unmarked sample blocks in fitted trays, each tray linked by a tamper-evident physical seal to one nearby instrument socket.
assets.single_mechanism: the fitted tray and seal preserve sample provenance between storage and measurement

assets.specific_physical_scene: A phased research hall with a simple coupon rack nearest the viewer and progressively enclosed thermal, reaction, and interface test bays farther away.
assets.single_mechanism: samples advance only when each increasingly specialized test bay supplies evidence

assets.specific_physical_scene: A magnetic specimen rests in a sealed side tray outside a nonmagnetic correction fixture whose empty cradle is clearly incompatible.
assets.single_mechanism: the workflow abstains by keeping unsupported magnetic material outside the correction fixture

assets.specific_physical_scene: A narrow pilot pipeline from powder hopper through sintering furnace to a pressure-test fixture, with one inspection gate interrupting the route before scale-up equipment.
assets.single_mechanism: the inspection gate admits only measured samples to the pilot press
